_doc: Phase F per-fail-final coverage SSOT (docs/verdict_policy.md Section 6.1). A multi-guard positive case whose guards are mutually exclusive in a single run cannot be promoted to FAULT_INJECTION by one _neg (one run reaches one final). Each entry maps every fail-final reason of the base case to the _neg<n> variant that proves it reachable. negative_coverage_audit.py cross-checks the keys against the base .scxml fail-finals (completeness) and that each variant is a real _neg sibling. Single-guard cases need no entry.
